programs.title: Agents on the Docks: Port Workers Govern the DAO
outcomes: Explain how agent-managed, human-governed DAOs assign tasks and route work at the Maasvlakte 2 container terminals
Identify which decisions (final votes, treasury transfers, appointments) remain reserved for human members
Draft and debate a mock proposal in the Proposal Forum format
Assess data-sharing risks for logistics workers in AI-coordinated delivery systems

sessions.activity: Study the DAO charter and contribution model; map which port-side decisions agents may prepare but only humans may enact.
Role-play with the Task Router scenario: working groups coordinate gantry-crane and delivery tasks between decision cycles.
Small groups draft a shift-scheduling or safety proposal; the Proposal & Grant Drafter agent formats it for human debate and vote.
Review sample progress metrics; discuss which measurable outcomes would count as success for port workers.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised session feedback on task-routing fairness and proposal priorities, aggregated with no names, employer IDs, or shift records.
programs.consent: Opt-in participation with a plain-language data notice in Dutch and English; union stewards briefed beforehand; any withdrawal deletes contributions.

programs.title: Cargo, Cranes and Collective Choices
outcomes: Locate the Port of Rotterdam's Maasvlakte 2 on a map and describe why Europe's largest port matters for delivery
Describe the difference between what AI agents do and what people decide in a DAO
Practice proposing and voting on a class decision
Reflect on sharing information safely online

sessions.activity: Use Evidence Monitor outputs to explore how goods move through the port and what agents summarize for humans.
Compare the DAO charter to class rules; identify the human-only decisions like final votes and appointments.
Teams draft a fun class proposal (e.g., delivery-themed game day); everyone debates and votes like DAO members.
Track class progress on a simple chart, mirroring how the Progress Tracker agent reports outcomes.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised class-vote tallies and drawings of 'what should humans decide', with no names, ages, or identifying details.
programs.consent: Written guardian/parent consent required before participation; teachers explain data sharing in age-appropriate terms; families may opt out at any time and contributions are removed.

programs.title: Governing AI as a Public Good: NGO Steward Workshop
outcomes: Connect the mission of governing AI as a public good to their own program portfolios
Operate the five-zone DAO workflow from evidence synthesis to progress tracking
Design measurable outcomes for a charter focus
Facilitate human-only reserved decisions within their organizations

sessions.activity: Analyze the charter's mission and contribution model; draft candidate measurable outcomes for an NGO-relevant focus area.
Work with Evidence Monitor and Research Synthesis Agent outputs to build an evidence brief for stakeholders.
Convert the evidence brief into a drafted proposal; rehearse human debate and the final vote reserved to people.
Use the Collaborator Scout and Task Router model to map partner working groups across decision cycles.
Define indicators and reporting rhythms with the Progress Tracker approach; peer-review each organization's plan.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised outcome frameworks and evaluation templates contributed to a shared NGO practice library, with organizational identifiers removed.
programs.consent: Organizational data-sharing agreement plus individual opt-in; no beneficiary or community data is shared; withdrawal removes materials from the library.

programs.title: From Evidence to Enactment: Nonprofit DAO Lab
outcomes: Understand the agent-managed, human-governed DAO structure of the Series 22 cell
Draft a fundable grant or proposal with agent support for human review
Apply consentful, privacy-first data practices to nonprofit programs
Report progress transparently against charter outcomes

sessions.activity: Review synthesized evidence on a chosen delivery-logistics challenge; practice summarizing for boards and donors.
Use the Proposal & Grant Drafter pattern to outline a grant request; peers critique before any human enactment step.
Map the nonprofit's mission onto the DAO charter template, highlighting human-reserved decisions like treasury transfers.
Build a simple progress dashboard aligned to measurable outcomes; present and get feedback.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised dashboard templates and lessons learned from proposal drafting, stripped of donor, beneficiary, and financial identifiers.
programs.consent: Board-level approval plus individual consent for any shared materials; privacy review before publication; opt-out honored with prompt deletion.
